I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is for **382 seats**.

That number comes from Tobias's Oct 14 post in #central-team, and nothing posted there since has changed it. I couldn't find any Marrow account files to check it against, so his message is the only source. Hollis is in that channel, so he can already see the post.
